items.subject: active TVL
items.reason: P02 does not define an authoritative active-liquidity denominator, so active TVL cannot be configured or matched.
items.requiredFollowUp: Freeze an authoritative active-liquidity source, unit, window, null policy, and metric version before enabling this condition.

items.subject: Fee/aTVL
items.reason: Fee/aTVL remains undefined while active TVL is unresolved.
items.requiredFollowUp: Resolve active TVL first, then freeze the Fee/aTVL numerator window, denominator instant, zero policy, precision, and metric version.

items.subject: target monitor field and UI parity
items.reason: The local contract is not backed by a complete authenticated target monitor capture across roles, themes, widths, and failure states.
items.requiredFollowUp: Capture authorized target monitor API and UI evidence and reconcile every field and state before a parity claim.

items.subject: live Telegram delivery
items.reason: P03-01 uses an explicit offline local sink and does not contact Telegram.
items.requiredFollowUp: Implement a secret-backed adapter and execute an approved staging delivery matrix without changing the local fixture contract.

items.subject: live external Webhook delivery
items.reason: P03-01 performs no DNS lookup, redirect, or external Webhook request.
items.requiredFollowUp: Implement the frozen egress policy and verify it against an explicitly registered staging endpoint.

items.subject: production delivery SLO and rate limits
items.reason: Retry timings and local limits are frozen as implementation inputs but have no production load or provider-quota evidence.
items.requiredFollowUp: Validate throughput, provider quotas, alerting, retention, and dead-letter operations in staging before release.
